effectSummary: Ao ser virada para cima, escolhe uma Armadilha do próprio Deck e a coloca no topo; se Necrovalley estiver no campo, pode adicioná-la à mão em vez disso.

design.deckSource: the current physical representative's private Deck, not the inactive teammate's Deck
design.necrovalley: hand destination is offered only when face-up Necrovalley is present at activation; if it leaves before resolution, the chosen hand mode falls back to topDeck; a later Necrovalley does not unlock hand mode
design.reveal: selected Trap is revealed to the opponent team; the inactive teammate's private hand remains concealed
design.mutation: adapter returns an immutable operation plan; central resolver performs the atomic move

testCoverage: source controlled by the team but physically owned by inactive partner
Necrovalley on either team's Field Zone
Necrovalley removed between activation and resolution

certification.reason: Adapter e testes isolados não registram o efeito no resolver compartilhado; handoff M61 permanece pendente.

limitations: Não integrado ao resolver principal nem ao handler Discord; depende do handoff M61.
Testes usam DuelState isolado; não substituem partida 2v2 real nem chamada à API Discord.
Não adiciona carta ao catálogo, allowlist ou certificações.
